sentences.en: I vowed that I would never speak to her again.
sentences.zh: 我发誓再也不跟她说话了。

sentences.en: With every broken vow, you bring our ideal closer to destruction.
sentences.zh: 每一次违背誓言，你们就把我们的理想推向毁灭。

sentences.en: I have made a vow never to get married.
sentences.zh: 我立下誓言永远不再结婚。

senses.zh: 誓言; 郑重宣布；许愿
起誓，发誓; 郑重宣告
